name: notion-workspace
description: Search Notion pages and databases, create and update records, and publish content to your workspace.

skills.name: create-database-row
skills.description: Insert a new row into a specified Notion database using natural-language property values. Handles property name matching and validation.

skills.name: create-page
skills.description: Create a new Notion page, optionally under a specific parent. Automatically structures content based on page type (meeting notes, project pages, etc.).

skills.name: create-task
skills.description: Create a new task in the user's Notion tasks database with sensible defaults for due date, status, owner, and project.

skills.name: database-query
skills.description: Query a Notion database by name or ID and return structured, readable results with optional filters and sorting.

skills.name: find
skills.description: Quickly find pages or databases in Notion by title keywords. Returns precise matches rather than comprehensive results.

skills.name: knowledge-capture
skills.description: Transform conversations and discussions into structured documentation pages in Notion. Captures insights, decisions, and knowledge from chat context with proper organization and linking.

skills.name: meeting-intelligence
skills.description: Prepare meeting materials by gathering context from Notion, enriching with research, and creating both an internal pre-read and external agenda saved to Notion.

skills.name: research-documentation
skills.description: Search across your Notion workspace, synthesize findings from multiple pages, and create comprehensive research documentation with proper citations and actionable insights.

skills.name: search
skills.description: Search the user's Notion workspace using the Notion MCP server. Use for finding pages, databases, and content by keywords or natural-language queries.

skills.name: spec-to-implementation
skills.description: Turn product or tech specs into concrete Notion tasks. Breaks down spec pages into detailed implementation plans with clear tasks, acceptance criteria, and progress tracking.

skills.name: tasks-build
skills.description: Build a task from a Notion page URL. Fetches task details, marks it in progress, implements the work, and updates status in Notion.

skills.name: tasks-explain-diff
skills.description: Generate a rich Notion document explaining code changes. Creates comprehensive documentation with background, intuition, code walkthrough, and verification steps.

skills.name: tasks-plan
skills.description: Create an implementation plan from a Notion task or specification. Breaks down requirements into actionable steps with estimates and dependencies.

skills.name: tasks-setup
skills.description: Set up a Notion task board for tracking tasks. Guides users through using a template or connecting an existing board.
